title: Deeper/broader AC1021 page-profile implementation follow-up
mode: ODA specification reconciliation, current LibreDWG source/merged-PR review, local implementation, and focused generated-byte validation
scope: Reconcile ODA v5.4.1 R2007 page-writing procedure with LibreDWG PR #1363 and current source
Implement a bounded AC1021 raw-versus-RS page classifier in the existing reader
Add in-memory tests to the existing reader-matrix target without fixtures or CTest registrations
Record the selected existing AC1021 smoke result and keep qualification/support claims gated

method.kind: Read ODA specification §§5.1, 5.4, 5.13; inspect LibreDWG PR #1363 and current decode_r2007.c; change local AC1021 page decoding and generated test owner; run focused validation
method.limitations: Generated byte vectors establish transform order, page geometry branches, failure behavior, and retry semantics only; they are not independent producer-authored DWG evidence. The existing tablet trace shows four uncompressed metadata page candidates whose extents do not match the calculated RS extent, but the raw prefixes do not match the recorded CRC under the current local calculation. The profile classifier follows the peer-reported non-RS page-size condition and retains these CRC mismatches as warnings; semantic correctness was not established. A clean HEAD build was compared: baseline and working tree both fail conversion with four system-page and 19 data-page CRC warnings, so the failure predates this slice.

sources.project: Open Design Alliance Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
sources.revision: Official published v5.4.1 PDF; §§5.1, 5.4, and 5.13 rechecked 2026-10-18
sources.observed: Section 5.1 broadly says each page may optionally be RS encoded, compressed, or encrypted. The detailed §5.4 data-section page writer says compression is skipped when not shorter, then the page is zero-padded and RS encoded using section-selected interleaving. Section 5.13 defines RS(255,251) and the interleave modes. The detailed writer procedure does not describe the no-RS metadata-page exception reported by LibreDWG.

sources.revision: Merged into LibreDWG master on 2026-08-07; conversation and verification reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The maintainer report distinguishes compression from RS. It reports that compressed and most uncompressed AC1021 data pages in one corpus match the computed RS extent, while four uncompressed metadata pages (SummaryInfo, Preview, AppInfo, FileDepList) are verbatim. The reported drawing reached ODA File Converter 25.6 entity/vertex parity after the fix; the PR also reports a finite corpus sweep. This is strong peer evidence for a compatibility profile, but not a universal specification rule or independent local result.

Current source computes RS physical extent as align32(ceil(align8(cSize)/251)*255). It always uses the RS decoder for compressed pages and uses the RS path for uncompressed pages when page.size equals that extent; otherwise it copies the uncompressed bytes. It does not use CRC arbitration for a page-size collision. The code comments identify page size as the available discriminator.

sources.project: Local libdxfrw implementation and generated reader-matrix tests
sources.revision: Working-tree implementation and test run 2026-10-18; baseline HEAD de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
sources.observed: The local decoder now rejects cSize > uSize, requires RS-sized geometry for compressed pages, selects the peer-reported no-RS profile for uncompressed pages whose physical extent differs from the computed RS extent (without requiring exact raw alignment), honors section interleaving, reports CRC mismatches as integrity warnings, and fails closed on unresolved extent collisions. Generated tests cover raw/RS stored pages, both interleave modes, RS-before-LZ77 ordering, compressed-no-RS rejection, extra tail padding, CRC-warning/no-CRC raw classification, collision evidence, output preservation, and same-reader retry.

sources.project: Existing local AC1021 tablet sample smoke

sources.observed: The existing test failed because dwg2dxf returned 1 after reporting reader21Ac1021CrcMismatch=23; the observations also reported operationSucceeded=true and legacyError=0. A clean build from unmodified HEAD was run against the same file in normal and debug modes and failed identically. Both traces showed four system-page and 19 data-page CRC mismatch warnings. The conversion failure predates this slice; the CRC cause remains open.

sources.project: Existing local AC1021 tablet page-map candidate census
sources.revision: Read-only dwg2dxf trace, direct byte inspection, and local CRC utility check 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The existing tablet.dwg trace reports four metadata pages with cSize == uSize and physical extents different from the calculated RS extent: SummaryInfo page.size=0x1a0, cSize=0x164, RS extent=0x200; Preview page.size=0x6dc0, cSize=0x6b7f, RS extent=0x6da0; AppInfo page.size=0x320, cSize=0x290, RS extent=0x300; FileDepList page.size=0x3a0, cSize=0x354, RS extent=0x400. Direct bytes at the SummaryInfo and AppInfo starts are plain metadata text. However, local crc64Mirrored(updateSeed1(0,cSize), rawPrefix) did not equal the recorded page CRC for all four pages. This is a candidate profile observation, not authenticated raw-page evidence; the correct CRC span/seed/field interpretation remains open.

assessment.localImplementationSlice: Implemented, locally generated-profile tests passing; producer/semantic qualification remains pending
assessment.selectedSmoke: FAIL three times in worktree and twice on clean HEAD: dwg_read_AC1021_tablet_v2010 (same 4 system-page + 19 data-page CRC warnings; failure predates slice)
assessment.nextAction: Investigate the four system-page and 19 data-page CRC mismatches shared by clean HEAD and the worktree; verify page offsets, seed handling, field widths, and CRC span against ODA and trace. Independently compare the tablet metadata semantics, keeping the no-RS route and downstream support claims unqualified until semantic evidence exists.
